title: Volatile Session Checkpoint + Resume Extension

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive after abrupt logout/page loss: solve the problem for future and integrate into self-improvement/system engines
Abrupt ChatGPT page/logout/re-auth interruption during active IVDIVO work
source_provenance.notes: Exposed volatile execution window; browser UI itself is outside project control
Existing continuation authority to extend, not replace
Covers supplied transcript recovery, not no-transcript in-flight state

problem_or_opportunity: The system can restore durable state and ingest copied transcripts, but an abrupt session loss can occur after meaningful work or a partial GitHub/Drive write and before enough orchestration state is persisted. The lost page may contain the only record of what write succeeded, what remains pending and what exact safe next action was selected.
proposed_mechanism: A compact hashed volatile-session checkpoint written at material boundaries. It records authority main SHA/state revision, selected next action, blocker state, durable/pending writes and volatile artifacts. Restart classification is fail-closed: RESUME_EXACT, REBASE_FIRST, RECOVER_VOLATILE_FIRST or STOP.
expected_benefit: Reduces duplicated work and manual recovery after abrupt session loss, prevents stale overwrite across parallel dialogs, and makes partial multi-store writes recoverable without storing whole chat transcripts.

acceptance_conditions: At least one real abrupt/restart recovery or equivalent production pilot
No false resume in adversarial stale/blocked fixtures
development_contract.rollback: Remove 18C/checkpoint hooks and revert machine pointer extension; existing 13/17/18B behavior remains intact.

pilot_evidence: 8 isolated deterministic unit tests PASS: exact resume, repository drift, state drift, pending write, chat-local artifact, tamper, secret rejection, blocker stop
Parallel-main movement during this same work block demonstrated the need for rebase-first behavior and prevented SI-0009 identifier collision
red_team_findings: Checkpoint must never become a second project-state authority
Do not checkpoint every thought/tool call; use material boundaries
Paid/irreversible/ambiguous external actions cannot be auto-replayed
Hash integrity does not establish authority freshness; main/state revision must be reread
Browser page restoration is outside this engine; the promise is frontier recovery, not UI restoration
next_action: Integrate on a fresh-main branch, run repository CI and diff Red Team, then mirror/read back Drive. Use first real abrupt-session restart as production pilot evidence.
hold_trigger: Any evidence that checkpoint cadence adds material production overhead, causes false resume, duplicates project state, or leaks secrets.
registry_write_status: PENDING_CENTRAL_COMPACTION; store as individual pending candidate to avoid risky rewrite of minified central registry.
